valuation.basis: current market cap vs the interim period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 9.76, price over EPS 16.36); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim HY 2026, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
